scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev -w web-server" "npm run dev -w web-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web-server && npm run build -w web-app
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p web-server && tsc --noEmit -p web-app
scripts.services:up: node scripts/setup-local.mjs && docker compose up --build -d --wait fund-service
scripts.dev:service: npm run services:up && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev:service -w web-server" "npm run dev:service -w web-app"
